title: Execution policy
description: The engine execution policy every run of a calculation is started with, described from outside the binary. The binary builds its own policy (serial, MPI, GPU) from the ranks it is launched on and its command-line options; these fields say which, in the names the `execution` block of results.json reports back. One value, handed to a workflow, reaches each of its units -- the SCF, the NSCF of a band structure or a DOS, every step of a relaxation. It names no binary: which one runs (q3, q3_mpi, a GPU binary) is the caller's choice. The Python model is q3.binary.ExecutionPolicy, which also accepts the launcher as one string and splits it as a shell would.

number_of_processes.description: MPI ranks. One runs the binary directly, without the launcher.

number_of_kpoint_pools.description: k-point pools, passed as --pools. Null leaves the choice to the input's control.number_of_kpoint_pools, or to the engine.

distribute_bands.description: Split each pool's bands over its ranks, passed as --distribute-bands.

precision.description: Arithmetic of the GPU binaries, passed as --precision. Null keeps the binary's default.

launcher.description: The MPI launcher placed before the binary when number_of_processes is above one, one word per entry, with {number_of_processes} where the rank count goes, e.g. ["srun", "-n", "{number_of_processes}", "--gpus-per-task", "1"].
